kind: Static source/dictionary review only; no application source edit, compilation, SDK action, simulation, network or performance measurement

source_identity.native_source_identity: Actual files are hashed; extracted source has no.git. Bind archive/pin provenance from the build owner before claiming a complete source/binary identity.

exact_scalar_aliases.required: Function-local lowercase small=numeric_limits<scalar>::epsilon(), great=1/small before including untouched C29 body. Do not alias to native SMALL/GREAT or define global/macro substitutions.
exact_scalar_aliases.note: COMPAT_OPENFOAM_ORG maps lowercase to native values; it does not restore Foundation14 epsilon values.

continuum_equations: dU/dt+div(U U)−div[nu(grad(U)+T(grad(U))−(2/3)I div(U))]=−grad(p)−sum_r[T_r n_r W_r/(rho V_r)]
p is kinematic; nu=1.5e−5 m2/s; rho1.225 kg/m3 appears in C29 force conversion only, not as another momentum multiplier

source_matrix.provenance: Both branches matrix operator==(A,B) returnsA−B; F14 fvModels.source(U) creates a zero source matrix with dimensions volume×velocity/time.
source_matrix.dimensions: [0 4 −2 0 0 0 0] for integrated incompressible momentum; source entry already includes cell volume and1/rho.
source_matrix.physical_sign: Positive C29 source is craft-normal direction; subtracting gives force on air opposite it. Directly adding positive C29 source to UEqn reverses the force.
source_matrix.assembly_order: Materialize momentum LHS, construct fresh zero temporary, host synchronization/access contract, call C29 once, subtract matrix, then normal relaxation/predictor; keep original UEqn for pressure correction.

full_laminar_stress.nu_face: interpolate(alpha*rho*nuEff); present incompressible single phase alpha=rho=1 and laminar nuEff=nu.
full_laminar_stress.divc_identity: F14 fvmDiv.C102–122: divc(tflux,U)=fvm::Su(fvc::div(tflux()),U), with extra faceFluxCorrectionPtr only if U flux is required.
full_laminar_stress.current_flux_required: Only p is explicitly flux-required. For this restricted case no U face-flux pointer needs reproducing; reject or implement it if a future input requires U flux.
full_laminar_stress.important: Do not replace with bare−laplacian or silently substitute a cell-centered tensor divergence. Solenoidal continuum simplification does not remove the discrete limited-gradient/face/boundary correction.

solver_selection.original: PIMPLE1 outer,2 pressure correctors,0 nonorthogonal correctors; momentumPredictor defaulttrue; consistent defaultfalse.
solver_selection.momentum: F14 final outer loop marks the momentum solve final before any PISO iteration; UFinal relTol0 is selected. Bare native ico/PISO default momentum solve selects U relTol.05.
solver_selection.minimal_fix: Preserve an original UEqn, create auto predictor=(UEqn == −fvc::grad(p)); predictor.ref().solve(mesh.solverDict("UFinal")); do not overwrite UEqn with the pressure-added predictor matrix.
solver_selection.pressure: Use native pEqn.solve(p.select(piso.finalInnerIter())) with2 correctors,0 nonorthogonal: p relTol.05 then pFinal relTol0, tolerance1e−7.
solver_selection.relaxation: No relaxationFactors in original dictionaries: F14 relaxationFactor() returns0; relax() is a no-op. Do not use relax(1), which can enforce diagonal dominance and change source.
solver_selection.alternative: Native PIMPLE1outer can be used instead of PISO, but still audit final flags/actual solver dictionaries; explicit UFinal is least ambiguous for the restricted app.

euler_flux.static_conditions: Fixed mesh, no MRF, Uf invalid/null, incompressible Euler. Then original ddtCorr(U,phi,Uf) reduces to fvcDdtPhiCorr(U,phi).
euler_flux.foundation: deltaPhi=phi.oldTime−dotInterpolate(Sf,U.oldTime); c=1−min(abs(deltaPhi)/(abs(phi.oldTime)+dimensioned_epsilon),1); c=0 on every noncoupled U patch; corr=c*deltaPhi/deltaT.
euler_flux.native: ddtPhiCoeff_ default−1, so standard interior limiter FORM agrees. Native SMALL is1e−15 versus F14 epsilon; native zeroes fixed-value/cyclicAMI patches instead of every noncoupled patch.
euler_flux.current_farfield: pressureInletOutletVelocity inherits directionMixed fixesValue=true in both branches, so current noncoupled farfield zeroing agrees. Difference is not a boundary-mask bug for this case.
euler_flux.minimal_exact_helper: Construct F14-style Euler correction locally with DP epsilon and!coupled mask and use interpolate(rAU)*corr in phiHbyA. No native core edit required; do not call the experimental correction variant.
euler_flux.scope: This helper is not a general moving-mesh, rho-weighted, MRF or other-time-scheme port.

steps: constrainPressure before pressure solve; laplacian(rAU,p)=div(phiHbyA), since C29 adds no mass/pressure source
phi=phiHbyA−pEqn.flux on final nonorthogonal correction; report each continuity correction
p.relax is identity for current no-factor dictionary; U=HbyA−rAU*grad(p); U.correctBoundaryConditions
pressure_flux_bc.no_op_conditions: Static mesh/no MRF/no extra fvConstraints; consistent=false. Assert these conditions rather than pretending a generic module port.
pressure_flux_bc.adjustPhi: Both implementations guard internally with p.needReference; native unconditional call is not itself a present-case physics mismatch.
pressure_flux_bc.farfield: Keep totalPressure p0=0 and pressureInletOutletVelocity with zero imposed tangential velocity, kinematic p units, volumetric phi. Do not replace totalPressure by fixedValue0.
pressure_flux_bc.gauge: totalPressure fixes p; p.needReference=false, and setReference is inactive unless forceReference is true. Never force a new gauge. Compare absolute p for this fixed-total-pressure case.
pressure_flux_bc.branch_bc_note: F14 totalPressure includes a tangential-velocity energy term; it vanishes for current zero tangential input. Nonzero/function-valued tangential inputs need a separate adapter.

dictionary_changes: Fresh private cases only; renamed application, no duplicate fvModels/fvOptions C29 evaluation. Preserve original fvModels as provenance/reference, not another active source.
Native transportProperties with dimensioned nu[0 2−1 0 0 0 0]1.5e−5; do not change physical viscosity or add another density factor.
If keeping pisoControl/createFields, translate original PIMPLE2-pressure/0-nonorth settings into PISO; retain U/UFinal,p/pFinal/smoothers/tolerances and explicitly select UFinal.

Keep Euler; grad(U) cellLimited Gauss linear1; div(phi,U) Gauss linearUpwind grad(U); laplacian Gauss linear corrected; interpolation linear; snGrad corrected. The old vol-tensor div entry alone does not reproduce the face-flux stress.

First cross-branch controls use the exact same fixed step sequence on a fresh Foundation14 reference and native candidate: adjustTimeStep false, explicit deltaT, no adjustable-write step rounding/function-object limits. Bare icoFoam does not reproduce Foundation14 adaptive ordering.
Preserve identical shared warm mesh/U/p/rotorParameters/geometry, initial phi policy and source reset semantics; record hashes and startup time.
controller_invariants: C29 body/include bytes unchanged; one process/one mesh per source-cache lifetime; no moving/topology-changing mesh.
Cache16×16 horizontal quadrature/vertical intersections and global per-rotor volume reductions; no geometry/mask optimization.
w_r=−volume-weighted(U·axis), airTarget per rotor, floor1 m/s, cap0.50 N, alpha=min(1,deltaT/.03).
Update thrust once per timeIndex, before momentum predictor; do not call in pressure loop or pre-call at startup for cache priming.
Warm first call at time>0.01 initializes target instantaneously; cold does not. Start/source/timeIndex and actual deltaT must match reference.
Keep density1.225 and original signed work/shaft/electrical diagnostics; do not log a newly corrected velocity in place of original pre-predictor sampling.
host_gpu_contract: The source loops remain host work. Verify chosen managed/unified mode and synchronization before host U/C/V/mesh/S access and before GPU use of modified source; temporary source zero-fill must be complete. Standard library/Field operations used inside C29 must satisfy host completion semantics. Do not infer safety on WSL from core arithmetic alone.
unresolved_branch_differences: Native global scalar constants outside the local C29/Euler helpers still differ from Foundation14.
Field/ldu/boundary data layout, limiter/interpolation implementation, Euler old-time registration, gradient/laplacian and floating-point reduction order may differ.
GAMG source recognizes directSolveCoarsest, but availability/performance/device execution of chosen smoothers and direct solve is not proven by that source declaration.
Fresh native parser/runtime-selection support for the actual saved U,p/BC syntax and complete finiteVolume libraries must be tested after builds.
The archive extraction has no local.git; source archive/pin, patches, compiler flags, libraries and binary hashes must be linked to the new method identity; never reuse CPU be7 signature.
Parent reports native/SPUMA core GPU arithmetic gates passed; remaining library/full-solver and C29 application gates are not established by this static review.

validation_gates.requirements: Exact original/body/include hashes; local alias values/DP/label-size logs; mesh/U/p/geometry/rotorParameters hash match; all supported-scope assertions.

Fresh source matrix has zero implicit/boundary coefficients and correct dimensions; rho×sum(applied negative integrated source)=−craftForce. Nonzero source points air opposite craft normal; no duplicate source.
Per-rotor volumes/weighted flux/controller states and TILT/work logs match fresh Foundation reference at identical times/steps, cold and warm first-call behavior; exactly one TILT per time index.
Compare viscous face flux/correction source, UEqn coefficients/H/rAU, Euler correction, phiHbyA, pressure matrices/fluxes, actual UFinal,p,pFinal selection and BC/gauge values on shared seed.

Fresh Foundation14 fixed-step versus ported native CPU reference, then same native application CPU versus GPU; predefine tolerances and inspect U,p,phi/force/work/residuals/all continuity corrections; preserve all discrepancies.
Full finiteVolume/application link and actual GPU work inside pressure/momentum time loops, supported memory access, no source-physics downgrade; core arithmetic/startup-only kernels do not suffice.

Only after accuracy passes, compare representative end-to-end wall time to best valid CPU reference with matched steps/inputs/accuracy and declared startup/cache/source work. This review records no speed or production-adoption claim.

conclusion: Plan is source-level viable only with the listed mandatory corrections/explicit restricted scope. No C29 application was compiled/run or numerically validated by this review; root owns a separate candidate implementation.
